notes: 1) hero.cta had a trailing space in en.json; trimmed it. 2) authSlice now stores machine-readable error codes which LoginForm/RegisterForm translate via auth.errors.* (dynamic key t('errors.'+code)). If a non-code string ever lands in state.auth.error, next-intl returns the raw key as text — verify authSlice stays code-only. 3) Roadmap milestones are stored as stable keys (dashboard.milestones.*) in onboardingSlice and translated at render time in dashboard-page; this assumes roadmap is only ever set by onboarding-page's handleGenerate. 4) Default props in SpecularButton.tsx ('children = "Get Started"') and AnimatedProgressBar.tsx ('ariaLabel = "Progress"') are intentionally NOT converted: SpecularButton's own default and AnimatedProgressBar callers pass t() values; SpecularButton's default is a pure fallback and all current callers pass children. 5) LanguageSwitcher 'EN'/'AR' are locale codes, intentionally untranslated. 6) src/shared/components/layout/Navbar.tsx (duplicate/dead navbar) is not imported anywhere and still contains hardcoded English; left untouched as dead code — recommend deleting it. 7) AiLearningPathCard previously used useTranslations on a missing 'aiLearningPath' namespace (would show the key itself / missing-message); now fully populated and its English default props are localized. 8) 'howItWork' namespace deliberately matches the existing home-section idiom (hero/features/cta) and is used by a Server Component (useTranslations works in RSC). 9) metadata now uses generateMetadata + getTranslations instead of static hardcoded metadata.
